svg.text: PXA (PXQ4) vs 1Cat vLLM (NVFP4), same V100 SXM2 NVLink system

8x V100-SXM2-32GB NVLink, 1Cat vLLM's own image, harness and cards (16 GSM8K questions, 192 greedy tokens), same window. Qwen3.8-27B + DFlash2 drafter. tokens/s. Grey = 1Cat vLLM, blue = PXA. Acceptance = accepted tokens/step.
1Cat vLLM: NVFP4 target + bf16 DFlash2 drafter, fp8 KV (its own runs, its own matrix)
PXA: PXQ4 target + PXQ4 drafter + PXA kernels, fp16 KV, inside the 1Cat image
Source: dgx-h2h-2026-09-07.csv. Both stacks use exact greedy-match acceptance; k=7 = medians of 3 alternating in-window boots each.
PXA: 15/16 speculative answers identical to its own non-speculative run; 1Cat: 10/16.
